style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: ribbon, jute sack and brass bucket are all gold, tan and caramel: golden satin keys with a rose-pink Enter, a treat of the same world and never red or violet

images.why: Opening: 'a tray of things: a ribbon, a bag of rice, a bucket of water'; Wrong: 'drops a long ribbon on the kilogram card'. A long thing to measure with the metre.
images.prompt: A long straight band of golden satin ribbon in a warm honey colour, with a smooth soft sheen and neat straight edges.

images.why: Opening: 'a tray of things: a ribbon, a bag of rice, a bucket of water'; Wrong: 'drops the bag of rice on the litre card'. A thing weighed in kilograms.
images.prompt: A small plain sack of rice made of natural jute in a warm tan, tied at the neck with twine, with a soft rounded belly and a gentle woven texture.

images.why: Opening: 'a tray of things: a ribbon, a bag of rice, a bucket of water'. A thing measured in litres. Made as a pail with no handle arch: the first two pictures were rejected (the white gap under a handle arch reads as background left inside).
images.prompt: A squat round pail of polished brass in a warm gold colour, with smooth sloping sides and a wide rolled rim, filled to the brim with clear water showing a gentle ripple, with a soft metal sheen.
